title: Spider-Man Could See the Cure. He Couldn’t Reach It.
description: Spider-Man is trapped beneath machinery while Aunt May’s medicine sits out of reach. A recap of Stan Lee and Steve Ditko’s If This Be My Destiny arc, especially The Amazing Spider-Man #33 (1966).
hook: Spider-Man could save Aunt May. The medicine was right there. He just couldn't reach it.
payoff: Peter breaks free, grabs the serum, and gets it to the hospital. Aunt May survives.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Spider-Man could save Aunt May. The medicine was right there. He just couldn't reach it.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In a classic comic, Doctor Octopus steals the serum she needs. Peter tracks him to an underwater base.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Then the machinery comes down. He's trapped under tons of steel as the room starts flooding.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The serum is only a few feet away. If he stays here, both he and Aunt May die.
units.onscreen: SO CLOSE. STILL OUT OF REACH.
units.visual_query: SO CLOSE. STILL OUT OF REACH.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He thinks of Uncle Ben. He already lost one person he loved. He refuses to lose another.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He plants his feet. The steel begins to rise. Inch by inch, he lifts the wreckage off his back.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Peter breaks free, grabs the serum, and gets it to the hospital. Aunt May survives.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: The villain didn't see this victory. The person who needed it was lying in a hospital bed.
